objective: Preallocate DML insert data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate DML insert data keys
tasks.result: DML insert and insert-select row writes now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>:<row_id> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in single-row insert, values-list insert/upsert, and INSERT ... SELECT data-key construction.
Generated key bytes, duplicate primary-key checks, ON CONFLICT behavior, row-cache lookups, row writes, indexes, RETURNING, and SQL results are unchanged.
The full sql_dml run printed a transient SSTable open retry warning before passing; final test result was green.
